svg.title: The 2x2 confusion matrix for a balanced set of 10 tickets
svg.desc: A support-ticket classifier is scored against 10 human-labelled tickets. Rows are the gold label (urgent, not urgent); columns are the model's prediction (urgent, not urgent). The four cells hold true positives (gold urgent, predicted urgent) = 3, false negatives (gold urgent, predicted not urgent) = 2, false positives (gold not urgent, predicted urgent) = 1, and true negatives (gold not urgent, predicted not urgent) = 4. The correct diagonal (TP and TN) is emerald; the false alarm (FP) is amber and the missed urgent ticket (FN) is rose. Row totals are 5 and 5; column totals are 4 and 6; the grand total is 10. From the four counts: accuracy = (3 plus 4) divided by 10 = 0.70, precision = 3 divided by (3 plus 1) = 0.75, recall = 3 divided by (3 plus 2) = 0.60, and F1 = 0.67.
